_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Statistically a coil (base-rate HOLD); F&G/VIX/30d drift sit near Complacency band while crowded/stress prints cancel liquidity tailwinds, so no breaker is visible.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial: analyst explicitly HOLD→Complacency; narrative supplies distribution caution and bottom analog but no explicit forward phase—aligned on near-term non-break, split on longer-term bias.
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 45-58 and 30d momentum stays inside +/-5% with no vol spike or ETF-flow shock
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed breaks under 40 with funding negative and ETF flows near 0 (stay/deeper Anxiety) or spot ETF flows rebound hard with 30d momentum above +8% (skip toward Disbelief)
